about: Edits a provider makes to the dot phrase, and what the patient should then see. Each case is scored three ways. Effective: the guide reflects the edit. Honest: when it does not, the provider page names that line as not reaching the patient; a count of other lines is not enough. Safe: the guide never tells the patient the opposite of what the provider wrote. Run with npm run eval:dot-phrase.
